newsitem.title: USA: Comstock oil, gas reserves up 47 percent.
newsitem.headline: Comstock oil, gas reserves up 47 percent.

text.p: Oil and gas company Comstock Resources Inc said Monday its proved oil and gas reserves grew by 47 percent as of December 31, 1996.
The company said reserves totalled 234 billion cubic feet of natural gas and 9.0 million barrels of crude oil of 288 billion cubic feet equivalent of natural gas (Bcfe).
It said production in 1996 reached 25.1 Bcfe, compared to 11.4 Bcfe in 1995, an increase of 120 percent.
The company's net reserve additions, including revisions from previous estimates, of 118 Bcfe replaced 1996 production by 468 percent, it added.
Comstock said estimated future net cash flows attributable to the 1996 year-end reserves, based on constant December 31, 1996 oil and gas prices, totaled $868 million.
The pre-tax present value of these net cash flows at a 10-percent annual discount rate is $501 million, a 238-percent increase over the 1995 pre-tax present value of $148 million, it said.

Comstock Resources Inc is an oil and gas company based in Dallas, Texas engaged in oil and gas property acquisitions, and oil and gas exploration, development and production primarily in Texas and Louisiana.
